chunks: And from a sermon of him (peace be upon him), in which he advises his companions.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali advise his companions about in his sermons?
ai.summary: In this sermon from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) addresses the impending *fitan* (tribulations) and the eschatological realities of the Day of Judgment, urging his companions to maintain steadfastness amidst political and spiritual turmoil. This passage reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on *taqwa* (God-consciousness) as the primary defense against the trials of the later era, linking historical events in Kufa to universal eschatological signs.
